title: Mooting guidelines to bar use of children in election campaigns: ECI to Madras High Court
description: The Election Commission of India (ECI) has informed the Madras High Court that it will examine whether guidelines are needed to restrain use of children in election campaigns by political parties [Vasuki Vs Election Commission of India]The submission was made by Chief Electoral Officer (CEO) Archana Patnaik in response to a petition seeking investigation into alleged corrupt practices by Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TMK), Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam (DMK) and All India Anna Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam
